name: Shun'e
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 85); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: All through the never-ending night
poems.author: Shun'e
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 85
poems.text:
All through the never-ending night
I lie awake and think;
In vain I look to try and see
The daybreak’s feeble blink
Peep through the shutter’s chink.
